$$
\begin{aligned}c\cdot d &={c}_{x}\cdot {d}_{x}+{c}_{y}\cdot {d}_{y}+{c}_{z}\cdot {d}_{z} \\  &=k\cdot 3+3k\cdot 3+(-6)\cdot 3 \\  &=3k+9k-18 \\  &=12k-18.\end{aligned}

$$
\begin{aligned}c\cdot d &=0 \\ 12k-18 &=0 \\ k &=\frac{3}{2}.\end{aligned}
$$
